title: 第十九章 豪赌第二十章 惊天逆转
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
擂台上情况突变，烈焰鹰在关键时刻，觉醒了自身属性。
浓郁的火焰，包裹住整个擂台，驯兽师无法靠近，越演越烈。
独角莽释放一次属性之力，处于衰弱期，恐怖的火焰瞬间将游过来的独角莽淹没，发出滋滋声。
妖兽被烤熟的味道，弥漫整个斗兽场。
火焰持续十分钟时间，烈焰鹰衰弱的趴在擂台上，艰难的活下来。
在它不远处，一尊被烧焦的独角莽只剩下一副躯壳，死的不能再死，活活的被烧死了。
“这不可能！”
万不同发出尖锐的叫声，事情怎么会这样，已经胜券在握，烈焰鹰怎么会觉醒属性，资料上显示，烈焰鹰觉醒属性的概率不及万分之一。
薛玉脸上闪过一丝骇然，输掉一场也许是巧合，连输两场，有些不寻常，每一次都是最后时刻翻盘，太诡异了。
万荣哲站起来，目光狠狠的瞪了一眼驯兽师，后者做出一脸无奈的样子，他也不知道烈焰鹰为何会突然觉醒属性，太巧合了。
每个人看向柳无邪的目光都变了，多了一丝敬畏，还有一丝困惑。
“哥，你是我亲哥，下一场告诉我买什么，我跟着买，万家富得流油，这次要狠狠的赚他一笔。”
松陵抱住柳无邪的胳膊，身体贴过来，宛如亲兄弟一般，惹来徐凌雪狠狠一顿大白眼。
万家的确富有，仗着斗兽场，日进斗金。
松家家主刚喝进嘴里的茶水突然喷出来，怎么养出这样一个活宝，当着万家家主的面，说出这番话出来。
“荣哲兄不要在意，小儿只是开个玩笑。”
松家家主赶紧打了一个圆场，虽不惧万家，没有必要撕破脸皮。
“见笑了，我们万家既然敞开大门做生意，就不怕输光家底。”
万荣哲皮笑肉不笑的说道，短短一炷香时间，万家输掉了一百五十万金币，还是让他一阵肉疼。
一百万金币如实奉送到柳无邪的桌子上，多了一沓卡片，里面记录详细的数字。

“柳无邪，敢不敢再赌一场。”
万不同有些癫狂，模样看起来很恐怖，头发散开，衣袍鼓荡，再输一场，恐怕会气的吐血致死。
“如果我说不呢？”
柳无邪突然笑眯眯的说了一句，刚才邀请他参赌，答应的很痛快，这一次竟然要说不，气的万不同狂喷老血。
“你……”
仰天倒下，输掉一百五十万金币，怒火攻心，加上柳无邪的言语刺激，活活的给气的晕过去了。
“万兄，万兄……”
田野泉赶紧上前摁住万不同的人中，怕真的死过去，等了约莫一分钟左右，万不同悠悠醒来，恐怖的杀意，犹如水银一般，铺天盖地。
“抬他下去吧！”
这时，一名青年才俊突然走上前来，丰神俊朗，一袭白衣，手中拿着扇子，翩然而至，站在万不同面前。
“是……是万卓然公子，他竟然也来了。”
content_en:
The situation in the arena suddenly changed, and the Flame Eagle awakened its attributes at the critical moment.
The thick flames enveloped the entire arena, making it impossible for the trainer to get close, and it became more and more intense.
The one-horned mang released his attribute power once and was in the weakening stage. The terrifying flames instantly drowned the one-horned mang that swam over, making a sizzling sound.
The smell of monsters being roasted filled the entire Colosseum.
The flames lasted for ten minutes, and the Flame Eagle lay weakly on the ring, struggling to survive.
Not far away from it, only a charred body of a horned mango was left. It could no longer die and was burned to death.
"This is impossible!"
Wan BuTong made a sharp cry, how could things be like this? He was already winning. How could the Flame Eagle awaken its attributes? The data showed that the probability of the Flame Eagle awakening its attributes was less than one in ten thousand.
A trace of shock flashed across Xue Yu's face. Losing one game might be a coincidence. Losing two games in a row was a bit unusual. Each time was a comeback at the last moment. It was so weird.
Wan Rongzhe stood up and glared at the trainer. The latter looked helpless. He didn't know why the Flame Eagle suddenly awakened its attributes. It was such a coincidence.
The way everyone looked at Liu Wuxie changed, with a hint of awe and a hint of confusion.
"Brother, you are my real brother. Tell me what to buy next time and I will follow suit. Wanjia is extremely rich. I will make a lot of money from him this time."
Song Ling hugged Liu Wuxie's arm and leaned close to him, like a brother, causing Xu Lingxue to roll her eyes.
The Wan family is indeed rich, relying on the Colosseum to make money every day.
The tea that the Song Family Patriarch just drank suddenly spurted out. How could he raise such a living treasure and say these words in front of the Wan Family Patriarch?
"Brother Rongzhe, don't pay attention. I was just joking."
The head of the Song family quickly smoothed things over. Although he was not afraid of the Wan family, there was no need to quarrel.
"What a joke. Since our Wan family has opened its doors to do business, we are not afraid of losing all our wealth."
Wan Rongzhe said with a smile. In just one stick of incense, the Wan family lost 1.5 million gold coins, which still made him feel pain.
One million gold coins were duly delivered to Liu Wuxie's table, along with a stack of cards containing detailed figures.
"Liu Wuxie, do you dare to gamble again?"
Wan Bu is a little crazy, and looks very scary, with his hair spread out and his clothes billowing. If he loses another game, he will probably vomit blood and die from anger.
"What if I say no?"
Liu Wuxie suddenly said with a smile that he had just invited him to participate in the bet, and he agreed happily. This time he actually said no, and he was so angry that he spewed blood.
"You..."
He fell to the sky and lost 1.5 million gold coins. He was so angry that he was so angry and stimulated by Liu Wuxie's words that he fainted from anger.
"Brother Wan, Brother Wan..."
Tian Tianquan quickly stepped forward and held down Wan Tong Tong, fearing that he would really die. After waiting for about a minute, Wan Tong Tong woke up, and the terrifying killing intent was like mercury, overwhelming.
"Carry him down!"
At this time, a young talented man suddenly came forward. He was handsome and handsome, dressed in white and holding a fan in his hand. He came gracefully and stood in front of Wan Dong.
"Yes...it's Mr. Wan Zhuoran, he's here too."
